library.gd_iter_step:
lemma gd_iter_step:
  "gd g (replicate (Suc n) 1) x =
    gd g (replicate n 1) (x - g x)"
  by (simp add: gd.simps replicate_Suc)
library.gd_cocoercive:
lemma gd_cocoercive:
  fixes x y :: 'a
  shows "inner (g x - g y) (x - y) \<ge> (norm (g x - g y))\<^sup>2"
proof -
  have h1:
    "f y + inner (g y) (x - y) +
       (1/2) * (norm (g x - g y))\<^sup>2 \<le> f x"
    using interp[where x=x and y=y] .
  have h2:
    "f x + inner (g x) (y - x) +
       (1/2) * (norm (g y - g x))\<^sup>2 \<le> f y"
    using interp[where x=y and y=x] .
  have h3:
    "inner (g y) (x - y) + inner (g x) (y - x) +
       (norm (g x - g y))\<^sup>2 \<le> 0"
    using h1 h2
    by (simp add: norm_minus_commute; linarith)
  from h3 show ?thesis
    by (simp add: inner_diff_left inner_diff_right; linarith)
qed
